requirement.statement: The converter SHALL expose three syntax profiles named Knl, Kon, and Kjson with distinct map/vector/knot container styles and profile-specific separator rules.

case.given: The Knl parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads map, vector, and knot values
case.then: The parser SHALL treat parentheses as maps, curly braces as vectors, and square brackets as knots.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads map, vector, and knot values
case.then: The parser SHALL treat curly braces as maps, square brackets as vectors, and parentheses as knots.

case.given: The Kjson parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads map, vector, and knot values
case.then: The parser SHALL preserve the JSON-like curly-brace map and square-bracket vector style.

requirement.statement: The Knl and Kon parser profiles SHALL use whitespace-only separation for array/vector and map entries and SHALL reject comma separators in these containers.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads an array containing comma-separated elements
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the input.

case.given: The Knl parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads a map containing comma-separated entries
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the input.

case.given: The Kjson parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads JSON-like map or vector syntax
case.then: The parser SHALL keep accepting the profile's JSON-like separator behavior.

requirement.statement: The Kon parser profile SHALL match the external Kon parser syntax for parser-level constructs, excluding interpreter behavior.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads a chain containing the `::` token
case.then: The parser SHALL tokenize and parse `::` as a container subscript operation in line with the external parser implementation.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads a word or chain name containing the `:::` token, such as `T1:::b` or `com.example.ClassA:::b`
case.then: The parser SHALL tokenize and parse `:::` as a source qualifier separator and preserve source and member name information for formatting.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads chain name, generic params, in/out table, conf, body, attributes, sections, and slots
case.then: The parser SHALL preserve equivalent AST information for formatting and downstream processing.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads quasiquote, unquote, unquote-splice, unquote-map, or row-spread syntax
case.then: The parser SHALL create AST nodes that preserve the quote or spread kind and inner value.

requirement.statement: The parser syntax baseline SHALL follow the external Kon documentation and implementation where `:::` is source qualification, `::` is container subscript, and `.:` is slot/static subscript.

case.given: The external project has implemented and documented `:::` source qualification
case.when: This TypeScript project synchronizes Kon parser syntax
case.then: The track SHALL use `:::` source qualification, `::` container subscript, and `.:` slot/static subscript as the synchronization baseline.

requirement.statement: The parser syntax SHALL support interpreted and raw string literals in both single-line and multiline forms.

case.given: A parser profile reads a double-quoted string literal
case.when: The literal is delimited by one double quote on each side
case.then: The parser SHALL parse it as an interpreted single-line string that supports escapes and interpolation.

case.given: A parser profile reads a triple-double-quoted string literal
case.when: The literal spans one or more source lines
case.then: The parser SHALL parse it as an interpreted multiline string that supports escapes and interpolation, with opening and closing delimiters on aligned delimiter-only lines.

case.given: A parser profile reads a single-quoted string literal
case.when: The literal is delimited by one single quote on each side
case.then: The parser SHALL parse it as a raw single-line string without escape processing and without interpolation.

case.given: A parser profile reads a triple-single-quoted string literal
case.when: The literal spans one or more source lines
case.then: The parser SHALL parse it as a raw multiline string without escape processing and without interpolation, with opening and closing delimiters on aligned delimiter-only lines.

case.given: A triple-quoted string delimiter has leading whitespace before the quote characters
case.when: The parser reads the multiline string content
case.then: The parser SHALL remove that same leading indentation from each content line before producing the string value.

case.given: A non-empty multiline string content line has a non-whitespace character before the delimiter indentation column
case.when: The parser reads the triple-quoted string
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the string as malformed.

case.given: A triple-quoted string closing delimiter is not aligned with the opening delimiter
case.when: The parser reads the triple-quoted string
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the string as malformed.

case.given: A triple-quoted string has content on the opening delimiter line
case.when: The parser reads the triple-quoted string
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the string because triple-quoted strings are multiline-only.

case.given: A triple-quoted string opening or closing delimiter shares its source line with any non-whitespace content
case.when: The parser reads the triple-quoted string
case.then: The parser SHALL reject the string because triple-quoted delimiters must be delimiter-only lines.

case.given: An interpreted double-quoted string contains single quote characters
case.when: The parser reads the literal
case.then: The parser SHALL allow single quote and triple-single-quote text as ordinary content.

case.given: An interpreted double-quoted string needs to contain its own delimiter text
case.when: The source uses escaped double quote characters
case.then: The parser SHALL support escaped double quote output for both single and triple double-quoted interpreted strings.

case.given: A raw string contains its own closing delimiter sequence
case.when: The parser reads the literal
case.then: The parser SHALL end the raw string at that delimiter and SHALL NOT introduce variable-length delimiter syntax.

requirement.statement: The parser syntax SHALL define string interpolation using backslash followed by the active profile's knot delimiter pair.

case.given: The Kon parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads an interpreted string containing backslash-parenthesized content
case.then: The parser SHALL parse the content between the parentheses as a Kon expression interpolation.

case.given: The Knl parser profile is selected
case.when: The parser reads an interpreted string containing backslash-bracketed content
case.then: The parser SHALL parse the content between the square brackets as a Knl expression interpolation.

case.given: Any parser profile reads a raw string literal
case.when: The raw string contains text that looks like interpolation syntax
case.then: The parser SHALL preserve that text literally and SHALL NOT parse embedded expressions.
